fact: Human Rights Watch says the youth movement GenZ212 called nationwide protests from 27 September 2025 criticising public spending on mega-sporting events and demanding more for health care and education.

Human Rights Watch reports the Agadir Court of First Instance sentenced a man on 4 October 2025 to four years in prison and a 50,000 dirham fine for 'inciting minor offenses and crimes via social media'.

EuroMedAI says opposition members in the House of Representatives proposed deleting part of Article 51 bis of Organic Law 53.25, arguing it could restrict freedom of expression; the Government did not accept the amendment.
